meta.name: ppt-animation
meta.description: 生成 PPT 风格的翻页 HTML 演示动画，支持暗色炫酷、暖色报纸、简约白色等多套主题，适合视频科普、技术讲解场景

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把内容变成翻页动画演示
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果想用动画形式展示讲解内容
copy.tagline_en: Turn content into page-flip animated slides
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want to present content with animated slides

howto.what: 装上后，当你提出做 PPT 演示时，Claude 会生成一个单文件 HTML 翻页动画：多页内容，支持键盘/滚轮/点击翻页，每页元素依次缓入显示，带页码和进度条，可选暗色科技、暖色报纸等主题。
howto.when: 当你的要求包含“PPT 演示”、“翻页演示”、“幻灯片”等词时触发。

say.text: 做一个关于太阳系科普的翻页演示，6页，暗色科技风
say.note: 生成一个完整可用的 HTML 演示文件。

say.text: 把第3页的文字改少，增加图形
say.note: 按你的要求修改现有演示。

say.text: 删除页码和进度条，保留键盘翻页
say.note: 按你的要求调整翻页控件。

howto.what_en: When activated, Claude creates a single-file HTML presentation with slide transitions. It includes multiple slides, keyboard/scroll/click navigation, sequential animations, page numbers and a progress bar, with themes such as dark-tech and warm-paper.
howto.when_en: Triggers when the user mentions keywords like 'PPT', 'slides', or asks for a slide-deck HTML animation.

say_en.text: Make a 6-page dark-tech presentation about the solar system.
say_en.note: Generates a complete HTML demo file.

say_en.text: Reduce the text on slide 3 and add more graphics.
say_en.note: Modifies the existing presentation as requested.

say_en.text: Remove page numbers and progress bar, keep keyboard navigation.
say_en.note: Adjusts the navigation controls as requested.
